description: Use when analyzing an employer H-1B compensation strategy or benchmarking tech sector wages against DOL prevailing wage data. Returns prevailing wage statistics, certified job titles, wage levels, and state distribution from DOL LCA filings. Example: Google H-1B — software engineer Level IV prevailing wage $195K, 1,243 certified positions in 2023 — concentrated in Mountain View and New York City offices. Source: DOL Labor Condition Application public data. $0.02 USDC per call.
name: get_employer_h1b_wages
